links.outcome: Text-to-SQL execution accuracy with metadata enrichment, decomposition, and retrieval versus baseline
links.effect: Accuracy improved from 88.0% to 94.5% for one-field queries and from 10.0% to 82.0% for three-field queries.
links.quote: Accuracy was improved from 88.0% to 94.5% for one-field queries and from 10.0% to 82.0% for three-field queries.
